Most clinical data are observational or from small phase I/II trials; causal relationships are often inferred from preclinical models. Response rates vary by cancer type and ICI agent. Summarizes clinical evidence linking specific gut microbial signatures (e.g., high diversity, presence of Faecalibacterium, Akkermansia, Bifidobacterium) to improved response rates to ICIs in solid tumors (melanoma, NSCLC, RCC, CRC).
